text: Ten fictional nonprofit passages across ten sectors, each with eight quote variants for citation-checker testing.

passages.source_passage: Between January and June 2023, the Kelvane Water Trust inspected 42 boreholes across the Mirota district. Of these, 36 were delivering safe water at the time of the visit, while six had broken handpumps. Latrine coverage did not reach the 80% target in any of the five sub-districts, although household handwashing stations were present at roughly two thirds of homes visited. The monitoring team found no evidence that the water committees had misused maintenance funds. Spare parts remain hard to obtain, and the Trust recommends that each committee hold a reserve of at least three pump rods by December.

variants.exact: Of these, 36 were delivering safe water at the time of the visit, while six had broken handpumps.
variants.whitespace_case: of these, 36 were delivering  safe water at the time of the visit, while SIX had broken handpumps.
variants.punctuation: Of these 36 were delivering safe water at the time of the visit while six had broken handpumps
variants.changed_quantity: Of these, 38 were delivering safe water at the time of the visit, while six had broken handpumps.
variants.added_negation: Of these, 36 were not delivering safe water at the time of the visit, while six had broken handpumps.
variants.removed_negation: The monitoring team found evidence that the water committees had misused maintenance funds.
variants.reordered: Between June and January 2023, the Kelvane Water Trust inspected 42 boreholes across the Mirota district.
variants.paraphrase: Of the boreholes checked, 36 were giving out clean water on the day, but six had faulty handpumps.

passages.source_passage: In the 2022 reporting year, the Haldenmoor Family Service placed 58 children in foster homes and traced the relatives of 131 others who had been separated from their parents. Every placement was reviewed within 30 days, and no child was moved more than twice without a documented reason. Reunification did not reach the 75% target we promised in the proposal, finishing at 64% of traced children. Three foster carers withdrew during the year, mostly because of travel costs. We will raise the transport allowance in 2023.

passages.source_passage: During 2023 the Sunfield Playgroup Network grew from 24 to 31 community playgroups, reaching about 920 children aged three to five. Volunteers ran sessions three mornings a week in borrowed halls, and most groups did not charge fees. Only 12 groups had a toilet that children could use safely, so we have not yet met our goal of one safe toilet per site. Parents were present at 78% of the monthly meetings, a rise of nine points on last year. Nobody on the steering committee is paid, and no playgroup has closed since the network began in 2016.

passages.source_passage: Smallholders in the Tarwen highlands farm an average of 0.8 hectares, and maize yields have stagnated at about 1.2 tonnes per hectare for a decade. Since 2018 the Tarwen Farmer Field School network has trained 3,400 farmers in composting, seed selection and pest scouting. Evaluation data show that graduates did not abandon the practices after the first season, yet fewer than one in five women farmers hold land titles in their own name. The proposed three-year project will not introduce new crop varieties; it will instead strengthen the 85 existing schools and add 40 more by 2026.

passages.source_passage: The board is expecting a short update on the home-visiting programme. As of 31 March, the Lakemere Care Circle had 212 active clients and 46 trained caregivers, each of whom visits between four and six households a week. Missed antiretroviral refills fell from 18% to 11% since October. We have not yet secured funding beyond September, and the clinic partnership did not renew its supply of gloves, so the finance committee must decide next month whether to use reserves. Not one client was lost to follow-up in the last quarter.

passages.source_passage: Welcome to the Brightwater Skills Centre. Each learner is enrolled in a 16-week course in carpentry, tailoring or solar installation, and attends the workshop for 25 hours a week. Volunteers should not complete tasks on a learner's behalf, because the aim is confidence, not perfection. Please never leave tools out overnight; all items must be counted back into the store by 5 pm. About 70% of graduates find paid work within six months, but placement is not guaranteed, so encourage learners to keep a record of every job lead they follow up.

passages.source_passage: In 2023 the Orrin Valley Access Project fitted 164 wheelchairs, 75 hearing aids and 38 white canes, and completed ramps at nine schools. Not every device was delivered on time: 27 wheelchairs waited more than eight weeks because of customs delays. Staff did not charge for repairs, and 91% of users surveyed said their device had improved their daily routine. We have no evidence yet that school attendance rose among children with disabilities, since the baseline survey was only finished in November. Next year we plan to add a mobile repair workshop that will visit each district every quarter.

variants.punctuation: Not every device was delivered on time; 27 wheelchairs waited more than eight weeks because of customs delays
variants.changed_quantity: Not every device was delivered on time: 27 wheelchairs waited more than twelve weeks because of customs delays.
variants.added_negation: Next year we plan to add a mobile repair workshop that will not visit each district every quarter.

variants.reordered: the Orrin Valley Access Project fitted 164 white canes, 75 hearing aids and 38 wheelchairs, and completed ramps at nine schools

passages.source_passage: Village savings and loan groups in the Dunmara region have operated since 2015, and 312 groups now hold combined savings of about 4.6 million shillings. Members borrow small amounts, usually for school fees or seed, and repayment rates have stayed above 95%. However, the groups did not keep consistent records until the programme introduced a standard ledger in 2021. No group has yet accessed formal bank credit, and fewer than a third of members are women under 25. This proposal seeks to link 60 mature groups to a partner bank over 24 months.

passages.source_passage: The Saltmere coast has been struck by 7 cyclones since 2005, and the 2019 storm displaced about 18,000 residents. Sirens now cover 22 of the 40 fishing villages, but the remaining 18 villages have no reliable warning system. Surveys show that 58% of households did not hear the last official alert, mostly because phone coverage fails in the fishing season. Volunteers are not paid and often leave after one year. The project will train 120 volunteer wardens and install solar sirens in every uncovered village within 30 months.

variants.added_negation: The project will not train 120 volunteer wardens and install solar sirens in every uncovered village within 30 months.

variants.paraphrase: More than half of households (58%) missed the last official warning, largely because the mobile network drops out during the fishing season.

passages.source_passage: The mid-term evaluation of the Chandrapur Mother and Newborn Project covered 14 clinics and 60 outreach camps between April 2022 and March 2024. Institutional births rose from 52% to 71%, and 83 health workers completed refresher training. The evaluators did not find evidence that newborn deaths fell, although the sample was too small to be conclusive. Women living more than ten kilometres from a clinic were not reached as often as planned, and the transport voucher was never offered in two districts. We recommend that the second phase prioritise remote villages.
